catalog_entry.title: Symbolic Stack Translation Pack
catalog_entry.summary: A translation pack for Human Design and natal astrology that foregrounds symbolic meaning load, identity adhesion, and non-equivalence rather than empirical flattening.
catalog_entry.notes: This pack is especially useful for symbolic systems that are culturally sticky and interpretively thick but not psychometric in the usual sense.

protocol.name: Translation Memo
protocol.purpose: Generate an evidence-aware memo about overlap, divergence, and incommensurability between selected frameworks or constructs.
protocol.summary: A compact comparative protocol for agents that need to explain how two or more systems connect without forcing a single unified language.
protocol.notes: Translation memos are useful baseline artifacts for both curation and downstream synthesis.

techniques.name: Cross-Framework Translation
techniques.purpose: Translate constructs across systems without forcing false equivalence.
techniques.summary: Compare constructs through shared motifs, relationship semantics, and epistemic bracketing rather than by naive one-to-one conversion.
steps: Identify source and target layers of personhood.
Compare through shared motifs before direct translation.
Mark overlap as strong, partial, inverse, symbolic, or incommensurable.
cautions: Do not flatten symbolic and psychometric systems into one evidence bucket.
Preserve asymmetry when one framework is broader or socially different than the other.

techniques.name: Symbolic vs Empirical Bracketing
techniques.purpose: Use symbolic systems without pretending they carry the same evidence type as psychometrics.
techniques.summary: Distinguish descriptive usefulness, symbolic resonance, and empirical status so that heterogeneous frameworks can coexist in one map.
steps: State its social or symbolic usefulness separately.
Preserve both without collapsing either into the other.
cautions: Inclusion in the map does not imply equal evidence.

canonical_records.short_description: A symbolic system combining astrology, I Ching, chakras, Kabbalah, and other traditions into a bodygraph-based self-description framework.
A symbolic charting system that interprets birth time and place through zodiacal and planetary symbolism.

motif.name: Symbolic Meaning Load
motif.summary: Degree to which a framework functions as symbolic, cosmological, or mythic meaning language.
motif.description: A motif for frameworks that do more than describe behavior and instead carry archetypal, spiritual, symbolic, or cosmological interpretive weight.

relevant_mappings.rationale: Human Design functions not only as a descriptive system but as a symbolic and cosmological language with heavy narrative meaning load.
Natal astrology is a strong house example of symbolic, mythic, and cosmological meaning language rather than only behavioral measurement.

interaction_hypotheses.summary: Symbolic meaning-heavy systems often become especially adhesive identity languages.
interaction_hypotheses.rationale: When a framework carries cosmological, archetypal, or destiny-coded meaning, users are more likely to adopt it as a durable self-story rather than as a lightweight descriptive layer.

execution_order: Resolve canonical framework records for the current target scope.
Trace target frameworks or constructs through the motif layer.
Expand interaction hypotheses relevant to the scoped targets and selected protocol.
Load the protocol's technique bundle and preserve cautions.
Bracket symbolic versus empirical status before claiming overlap.
Explain overlap, divergence, and incommensurability directly.
Emit mismatch warnings and suggested follow-up mappings.
Return structured feedback through the preferred research contribution models.

contribution_models.name: Mapping Vote
contribution_models.purpose: Collect lightweight feedback on whether a proposed mapping fits lived experience.
contribution_models.privacy_posture: No raw narrative required; contribution should stay at the judgment layer by default.
contribution_models.notes: Best default research input when the goal is to refine construct-to-motif mappings without collecting sensitive life detail.

contribution_models.name: Pairwise Relation Judgment
contribution_models.purpose: Capture whether two result atoms feel reinforcing, contradictory, orthogonal, or context-dependent.
contribution_models.privacy_posture: Structured labels first; free text only if strictly necessary.
contribution_models.notes: Useful for discovering stable tension and reinforcement patterns across systems.

contribution_models.name: Distilled Observation
contribution_models.purpose: Record short anonymized insights about how mappings, tensions, or combinations behave in practice.
contribution_models.privacy_posture: Distilled and anonymized by default; no raw transcripts in the canonical stream.
contribution_models.notes: Useful for preserving real-world synthesis insight without over-collecting sensitive detail.

contribution_models.name: Protocol Feedback
contribution_models.purpose: Capture whether a downstream protocol produced useful, misleading, or incomplete synthesis.
contribution_models.privacy_posture: Evaluate the protocol output rather than the person's raw life material.
contribution_models.notes: Keeps downstream promptcraft and runtime behavior connected back to the repository without polluting canonical framework records.
